Boxplot

plot_boxplot.Rd

Draw a boxplot. Currently supported data types:

  • SummarizedExperiment: A glyexp::GlycomicSE(), glyexp::GlycoproteomicSE(), or other compatible container. Expression values are plotted, grouped by the group column, with scale-aware log transformation controlled by log_transform.

Usage

plot_boxplot(
  x,
  ...,
  group_col = "group",
  ncol = NULL,
  label_width = 24,
  scales = "free_y",
  log_transform = NULL,
  points = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL,
  variables = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'glyexp_experiment'
plot_boxplot(
  x,
  ...,
  group_col = "group",
  ncol = NULL,
  label_width = 24,
  scales = "free_y",
  log_transform = NULL,
  points = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'SummarizedExperiment'
plot_boxplot(
  x,
  ...,
  group_col = "group",
  ncol = NULL,
  label_width = 24,
  scales = "free_y",
  log_transform = NULL,
  variables = NULL,
  points = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  fontsize = 9,
  family = "sans",
  palette = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An object to be plotted.

...

Must be empty. Supply plotting controls by their full argument names.

group_col

A character string specifying the column name in sample information that contains group labels. Default is "group".

ncol

Number of facet columns. NULL chooses up to three columns.

label_width

Width used to wrap facet labels without truncation.

scales

Facet axis scales, passed to ggplot2::facet_wrap(). Defaults to "free_y"; use "fixed" for comparisons across facets.

log_transform

NULL (default) uses recorded abundance scale metadata: raw values are transformed with log2(x + 1e-6), while already logged values are unchanged. FALSE always uses the supplied values unchanged. TRUE requests the same transformation for raw values, but warns and is ignored for already logged values. This argument must be named after ....

points

Whether to show observations as jittered points. Boxes show medians and quartiles with 1.5-IQR whiskers. Outliers are drawn separately only when points = FALSE.

title

Optional plot title. Defaults to NULL.

width, height

Plot-area dimensions in millimetres. NULL uses the tidyplots defaults (50 by 50 mm); NA fills the available graphics device. These are not export-page dimensions.

fontsize

Base text size in points. Defaults to 9.

family

Font family. Defaults to "sans".

palette

Color vector. A named vector maps group names to fixed colors across plots and subsets; unnamed palettes follow factor order. NULL uses tidyplots palettes. Heatmaps and correlation plots use the blue, near-white, and red anchors of colors_diverging_BuRd. Volcano plots use grey for points that do not meet both cutoffs. Other plots use the tidyplots defaults for discrete and continuous values.

variables

A character vector of row names to plot from a SummarizedExperiment. NULL (the default) plots all rows. Names must exist in rownames(x). Matching rows retain their original order; repeated names in variables do not repeat rows. The 25-variable limit applies after selection.

Value

A tidyplot object, also inheriting from ggplot.

See also

glyvis_abundance_scale for scale metadata and compatibility rules.
